title: THE MIDNIGHT PLATFORM
premise: Every midnight, a train returns one person who disappeared. Bringing that person home requires somebody else to take their place.
story_engine: Each episode delivers one complete emotional choice, one materially different supernatural railway event, and one clue that advances the season mystery.

arin.identity_lock: Indian boy, warm brown skin, expressive dark-brown eyes, thick wavy black hair swept right, mustard hooded jacket, charcoal shirt, dark teal trousers, worn red high-tops, brass station badge
arin.core: Acts before fear can stop him; hides guilt behind responsibility.

meera.identity_lock: Indian girl, warm brown skin, large dark eyes, shoulder-length black hair, turquoise hair clip, deep teal coat, cream scarf, maroon boots
meera.core: Observant and brave; remembers fragments the train erased from everyone else.

tick.identity_lock: Small quadruped clockwork fox, copper and ivory enamel, cyan eyes, notched right ear, segmented brass tail with blue tip; never humanoid or bipedal
tick.core: Tracks broken time and communicates through mechanical behavior rather than exposition.

conductor.identity_lock: Tall figure in midnight-navy double-breasted railway coat with antique brass piping, black gloves, high collar, midnight-navy railway cap with brass badge, aged ivory circular clock-face mask showing black numerals and hands near midnight, narrow black eye openings and no mouth
conductor.core: Elias D'Souza, Maya's older brother and a former passenger; enforces the exchange rule while searching for a survivable way to end it.

saira.identity_lock: Indian teenage girl with deep umber skin, short tight black curls shaved above the left temple, rust-red railway vest over slate shirt, patched black trousers, worn brown boots, silver compass necklace
saira.core: Taken in 1998 after saving her little brother from a fire; resourceful, skeptical, and terrified that returning home will prove she has no home left.

maya.identity_lock: Goan Indian woman with warm brown skin, silver-streaked chin-length black bob, round brass glasses, plum shawl over retired cream-and-navy stationmaster uniform, carries a dented brass handbell
maya.core: The last stationmaster who remembers Platform 13 and the younger sister Elias exchanged himself to save in 1976.

nila.identity_lock: Indian girl from 1913 with brown skin, long braided black hair, indigo railway dress with copper stitching, bare feet, pale clock-light glowing through fine cracks along her hands
nila.core: Passenger Zero and the first life rescued from a fatal railway minute; wants every passenger restored immediately even if the memory debt empties the living city.

lore_lock.origin: In 1913, railway engineer Devika Rao rewound one fatal minute to save thirteen people, including her daughter Nila. The unpaid minute became the Midnight Train; Nila boarded voluntarily as Passenger Zero to hold the corrected history together.
lore_lock.selection_rule: The train collects people whose lives were previously saved from a death that should have occurred. Meera was taken after saving Arin from the train 317 nights before Episode 1.
lore_lock.exchange_rule: A passenger can return only when another person willingly carries that passenger's unpaid minute.
lore_lock.memory_debt: Forcing a passenger out without a replacement makes the surrounding city pay by losing a shared memory. The physical world survives, but relationships and civic history become increasingly hollow.
lore_lock.ending_rule: The debt can be distributed only through informed voluntary sacrifice; one freely offered memory from many people can replace the theft of one whole life.

season_arcs.title: The Exchange
season_arcs.promise: Arin boards the train to save Meera and must survive twelve impossible carriage doors while Meera and Tick search for a way to call the train back.
season_arcs.payoff: The siblings reopen Platform 13, but learn every rescued passenger deletes a different memory from their city.

season_arcs.title: The Erased City
season_arcs.promise: Meera follows disappearing memories across the city while Arin discovers the passengers were removed for a reason.
season_arcs.payoff: The Conductor is revealed as a former passenger who once made the same sacrifice as Arin.

season_arcs.title: The Last Stop
season_arcs.promise: The siblings reunite and must choose between restoring everyone the train took or preserving the world that replaced them.
season_arcs.payoff: The exchange cycle ends through a character decision established in Episode 1; the season closes completely while leaving the wider KAAPAV ARC universe open.

anti_dilution_rules: No repeated rescue structure or repeated outcome.
Every episode permanently changes a relationship, rule, location, or objective.
Every ten-episode arc must resolve its advertised central question.
Episodes 31-50 require a new approved arc and are not automatic extensions.
